Data:Salon.setup.formal.json.label: A Formal Meal

Data:Salon.time.remaining.json.label: Salon: Time Remaining
Data:Salon.time.remaining.json.desc: [Your guests will remain until this is gone.]

Data:Salon.voices.json.label: A Salon in the Hall of Voices
Data:Salon.voices.json.desc: An eccentric, or at least atmospheric, choice of venue for a Salon. [Here one might have Elevenses in the morning, or Afternoon Tea later in the day. Neither event should include any Intoxicating drinks.]

slots.label: Secretary Persistent
slots.description: In Hush House, an empty place is often traditionally left at table for Rowena, protectress of Hush House, and once Secretary Persistent of the Curia of the Isle. [If you one day propose a successor for Rowena... seat them here.]

Data:Salon.ys.deadlock.json.label: Deadlock
Data:Salon.ys.deadlock.json.startdescription: One founder insisted we should ally with Ys; another refused, warning of Ys' legendary and fundamental treachery.
Data:Salon.ys.deadlock.json.desc: [Deadlock: founders have opposing Fear/Sympathy. We can't inaugurate the Institute with Ys as either an Ally or a Foe]

Data:Salts.bitterblack.json.Label: Bitterblack Salts
Data:Salts.bitterblack.json.Desc: Bitter as chicory, dark as secrets, but the first rung of the traditional alchemical ascent.

xexts.scrutiny: There's a brightness locked within. Keeper-level Forge or Lantern might transform these into a more potent essence. [And Prentice-level Forge can be used with certain recipes to create more Salts.]

Data:Sand.json.Label: Sand
Data:Sand.json.Desc: An hourglass, of course, is sand contained by sand.

Data:Sandwiches.egg.json.Label: Egg Sandwiches
Data:Sandwiches.egg.json.Desc: Ennobled by cress but acceptable without.

Data:Satisfying.echidna.json.label: Satisfying Echidna
Data:Satisfying.echidna.json.desc: To make sure we don't accidentally also satisfy a visitor we're retiring

Data:Satisfying.json.label: Satisfying
Data:Satisfying.json.desc: e.g. helping out a visitor. We can use it both for marking them for embarkation, and for satisfaction comments

Data:Savage.relic.json.Label: Savage Relic
Data:Savage.relic.json.Desc: A shrieking little bundle of primordial ill-temper.

xexts.scrutiny: Its sigils evolve with age… but it ages so very slowly.

Data:Saw.json.Label: Saw
Data:Saw.json.Desc: Eternally useful, though not for most librarians most of the time.

Data:Scale.json.label: Scale
Data:Scale.json.desc: Hard without, hard within, hard to rouse, harder to subdue. [What is left of the crude powers of the deep earth.]

Data:Scale.only.hint.json.label: Now What?
Data:Scale.only.hint.json.startdescription: There's potential here. [Start by adding a Soul card.]
